title: MobileInput.cs
summary: Static bridge from the on-screen joystick/Interact button to the same signals keyboard input already produces, so gameplay scripts never need a separate 'mobile' code path, including the View button that switches between third and first person.

notes.text: One-frame pulse flag for the Interact button, analogous to WasPressedThisFrame().
Read-only accessor — nothing outside this class should be able to set _interactPressed directly except TriggerInteract.
Called once by the Interact button's onClick — sets the pulse flag that every interaction script checks this frame.
Reset at the end of every frame so the pulse only counts for the frame the button was actually pressed, not forever after.
The current movement stick position, a Vector2 from the on-screen joystick.
Called continuously by MobileJoystick while dragging, and with Vector2.zero on release.
Clamp to length 1 so dragging past the edge of the stick never moves faster than full speed.

The on-screen VIEW button sets this latch; PlayerMovement consumes it once per frame and toggles first person. A latch (read and cleared by the consumer) is used instead of a per-frame flag so the press survives whichever LateUpdate happens to run first.
